queries.snapshot: SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation, now()::text AS captured_at
queries.ammoSummary: SELECT count(*) AS total_aliases, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.resource_id IS NULL) AS null_resource_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND r.id IS NULL) AS dangling_resource_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT r.is_active) AS inactive_existing_resource, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.name LIKE '%fmap-%') AS test_marker_aliases FROM faita.resource_alias_with_ammo a LEFT JOIN public.resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id
queries.ammoInvalidAliases: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.ammunition_id AS faita_id, a.resource_id, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at::text, a.updated_at::text, CASE WHEN a.resource_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_RESOURCE_ID' ELSE 'DANGLING_RESOURCE_ID' END AS scenario FROM faita.resource_alias_with_ammo a LEFT JOIN public.resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
queries.initiatorsSummary: SELECT count(*) AS total_aliases, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.resource_id IS NULL) AS null_resource_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND r.id IS NULL) AS dangling_resource_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT r.is_active) AS inactive_existing_resource, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.name LIKE '%fmap-%') AS test_marker_aliases FROM faita.resource_alias_with_initiators a LEFT JOIN public.resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id
queries.initiatorsInvalidAliases: SELECT a.id, a.name, a.initiator_id AS faita_id, a.resource_id, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at::text, a.updated_at::text, CASE WHEN a.resource_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_RESOURCE_ID' ELSE 'DANGLING_RESOURCE_ID' END AS scenario FROM faita.resource_alias_with_initiators a LEFT JOIN public.resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
queries.aliasResourceColumns: SELECT table_name,column_name,is_nullable,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='faita' AND table_name IN ('resource_alias_with_ammo','resource_alias_with_initiators') AND column_name='resource_id' ORDER BY table_name
queries.aliasConstraints: SELECT c.conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name,c.conname,c.contype::text, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid IN ('faita.resource_alias_with_ammo'::regclass, 'faita.resource_alias_with_initiators'::regclass) ORDER BY table_name,c.conname
queries.importAndAliasTriggers: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,c.relname AS table_name,t.tgname, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) AS definition,pg_get_functiondef(t.tgfoid) AS function_definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND ((n.nspname='faita' AND c.relname IN ('resource_alias_with_ammo','resource_alias_with_initiators','ammo_agg_v3','ammunition','initiators')) OR (n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='resource')) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname
